messages:
maria: FYI AWS sent an advisory with a few K8s component CVEs we need to triage and schedule. CVE-2026-0987 (kubelet privilege escalation), CVE-2026-1022 (etcd auth bypass), CVE-2026-1100 (nginx-ingress controller path parsing). Thinking: quick staging canary + RBAC audit before prod. :eyes:
jonas: Thanks. Quick question — do we have a matrix of clusters by control-plane version and ingress chart version? I can assemble.
lee: I pulled inventory yesterday. Most clusters: k8s 1.26.x and 1.27.x, etcd 3.5/3.6 split, ingress-nginx chart v1.5 -> v1.7 ranges. Will attach list to the incident doc.
anil: For kubelet CVE, are we limited to node agent upgrades or is there an upstream kubelet patch we can apply without full node reimage?
maria: Kubelet patch is in downstream kernel+kubelet package for our images. Short-term: schedule OS image roll with node drain. Long-term: evaluate livepatch for critical kernels.
sophia: On RBAC: cert-manager and our controller-manager service accounts may need new permissions after ingress controller upgrade (webhook changes). We should run 'kubectl auth can-i' checks in staging.
jonas: Agreed. I'll run can-i for these SAs and list fails. Also check PSP/PSA migration impacts.
secops-bot: [automated] Vulnerability ticket created: VULN-2026-389 (kubelet), depends_on: VULN-2026-390 (etcd). Priority: high.
ops-runner: Proposed rollout plan: 1) staging cluster: full upgrade + smoke tests 2) a single non-prod region in prod 3) prod canary (10% nodes) 4) full prod. Each step gated by automated test and audit-log verification.
maria: +1. Add RBAC preflight and audit-forwarding verification to gate. We want to ensure audit logs reach SIEM for at least 48h after change.
sophia: KMS question — upgrading etcd may require rekey of snapshot encryption if we change storage class. Anyone on call for KMS rotate runbook?
anil: I can coordinate KMS. We must confirm HSM-backed keys exist for staging too. I'll validate key policies and ensure Vault roles are intact.
jonas: Preflight commands I'm running in staging:```bash
# check SA permissions
kubectl -n cert-manager auth can-i create certificaterequests --as=system:serviceaccount:cert-manager:cert-manager
# verify ingress nginx version
helm --kube-context staging ls -n ingress-nginx
# run e2e smoke
kubectl -n default run smoke --image=hashicorp/http-echo -- curl -s http://ingress.example/health
```
lee: For rollback: we will pin helm chart revisions and keep previous replica sets warm. Rollback command snippet: `helm rollback ingress-nginx <REVISION> -n ingress-nginx` and `kubectl rollout undo ds/kubelet-daemonset -n kube-system` for nodes if needed.
maria: Good. Also add a config audit to detect dropped apiGroups by RBAC changes. Use rbac-lookup and kubeaudit.
jonas: Timeline proposal: start staging tonight 00:30 UTC, prod canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC window. If anything flakey, rollback within 30 minutes.
sophia: I'll own audit log verification and KMS key checks during the windows.
anil: I'll prepare runbook steps for rekey and pre/post etcd snapshot checks.
ops-runner: Can someone prep a short runbook snippet for the on-call? Keep it <= 10 steps with exact commands.
maria: I'll draft runbook and post to #incidents + paste the short version here before staging. Please react with :thumbsup: when you can run the checks.
jonas: Running checks now, will post results in 15m.
lee: One more item — ensure node-exporter and metrics scraping resilience; ingress upgrade can add 502s. Add a traffic ramp in canary.
maria: Noted. Thanks team.
jonas: (update) staging preflight: cert-manager SA missing `create` on certificaterequests in staging. Raising PR to add minimal role.
sophia: Thx — approve lowest-privilege change. Post PR link when ready.
secops-bot: [automated] Audit forwarder test success in staging at 1737077880.
maria: OK moving forward once PR merged and staging smoke green. I'll update thread when we start the window.
